## Libraries

```{r, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Data import and preparation

```{r, message = FALSE}

exp <- read_csv("data/lab_exp.csv")
exp_long <- exp |> pivot_longer(personnel:total, 
                                names_to = "type",
                                values_to = "cost")
```

## Create graph

```{r}
ggplot(data = filter(exp_long, 
                department %in% c("Chemistry", "Blood Bank", 
                                  "Microbiology", "Hematology"))) +
  geom_bar(mapping = aes(x = department, 
                         y = cost, 
                         fill = type), 
           stat = "identity",
           position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Cost ($)", 
       title = "")
```

## Conditionals

```{r}
select_pan <- function(baked_good) {
  if (baked_good == "cupcake" | baked_good == "muffin") {
      pan <- "cupcake tin"
  } else if (baked_good == "cake") {
    pan <- "round cake pan"
  } else {
    pan <- "square cake pan"
  }
  return(pan)
}

```

```{r}
select_pan(baked_good = "cupcake")
```

```{r}
select_pan(baked_good = "muffin")
```

```{r}
select_pan(baked_good = "cake")
```

```{r}
select_pan(baked_good = "brownie")
```

## Loops

```{r}
# create a toy data set
df <- tibble(
  a = rnorm(10),
  b = rnorm(10),
  c = rnorm(10),
  d = rnorm(10)
)
```

```{r}
# manually calculate median for each column via copy/paste
median(df$a)

median(df$b)

median(df$c)

median(df$d)

```

```{r}
# use a for loop to apply the median function across all columns

output <- vector("double", ncol(df))  # 1. output
for (i in seq_along(df)) {            # 2. sequence
  output[[i]] <- median(df[[i]])      # 3. body
}
output

# output is the result you want after executing code for each iteration in the sequence, here is the median value
# sequence defines what to loop over, here is each column of the dataframe
# body is the code that will be repeated, here it is the median function
```

```{r}
# use a function that abstracts for loops
df |> map_dbl(median)
```

## Prompting

```{r}
glu <- read_csv("data/fasting_glucose_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(glu, aes(x = site, y = fasting_glucose_mg_dL, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = site), width = 0.12, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 126, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = 100 mg/dL, Dotted line = 126 mg/dL",
    x = "",
    y = "Fasting glucose (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
glu |> group_by(site) |> summarise(median = median(fasting_glucose_mg_dL))
```

```{r}

ggplot(glu, aes(x = site, y = fasting_glucose_mg_dL)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Fasting Glucose Distributions by Hospital Site",
    y = "Fasting Glucose (mg/dL)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
